April 2026 – Royal Caribbean’s newest vacation, Legend of the Seas, has officially taken to the ocean for the first time during a series of sea trials. Over the next 10 days, Legend will go through various technical examinations on the open water to prepare for its highly anticipated European debut this summer. Abril de 2026 – Las nuevas vacaciones de Royal Caribbean, Legend of the Seas, navegan oficialmente por primera vez durante una serie de pruebas en el mar. Durante los próximos 10 días, Legend pasará por varias evaluaciones técnicas en aguas abiertas en preparación para su esperado debut en Europa este verano.Show More Entertainment on Legend of the Seas On Royal Caribbean’s Legend of the Seas, vacationers can experience a variety of large-scale entertainment productions across air, ice, water and stage, along with live music, parties and experiences for families of all ages. Headlining the lineup are Roald Dahl’s “Charlie and the Chocolate Factory” making its golden ticket debut at sea and iconic acts during America’s Got Talent LIVE on Legend of the Seas. Guests can marvel at high-diving performances during “Shockwave” at the AquaTheater, witness world-class ice-skating at “Fusion” in Absolute Zero and celebrate Royal Caribbean destinations in the Royal Promenade’s “Voyage to Adventure” parade. Beyond the stage, guests can enjoy the ultimate night out with live music and more than 10 parties onboard. Plus, families have their own lineup of activities, from the “Larger than Life Family Festival” for young ones and a special father-daughter dance to adventures for the whole crew at laser tag, game shows, karaoke and more.Show More On Chill Beach at Royal Caribbean’s Royal Beach Club Paradise Island, families up to 10 can unwind and enjoy quality time at the Panoramic Spacious Pool Cabanas with breathtaking views.Show More Perfect Day Mexico Community Pillars Perfect Day Mexico Economic Pillars Perfect Day Mexico Environmental Pillars Perfect Day Mexico Pilares de la Comunidad Perfect Day Mexico Pilares Económicos Perfect Day Mexico Pilares Medioambientales March 2026 – Royal Caribbean’s Hero of the Seas features new accommodations for multi-generational families, including the first-of-its-kind Ultimate Family Treehouse. Marzo de 2026 - En Hero of the Seas de Royal Caribbean, los vacacionistas pueden tomar mientras se bañan en la piscina ampliada Swim & Tonic y el bar en piscina, que ofrece aún más espacio para que los adultos descansen más que nunca.Show More March 2026 – Royal Caribbean has introduced the boldest evolution of family vacations with Hero of the Seas, the fourth Icon Class ship arriving to Miami in August 2027. Marzo de 2026 – Las mejores vacaciones familiares en Hero of the Seas de Royal Caribbean ofrecerán más experiencias memorables para las familias con nuevas clases de cocina. Los huéspedes de todas las edades pueden aprender habilidades culinarias juntos con una variedad de cursos, desde recetas emocionantes para los más pequeños hasta tareas más avanzadas para los adultos.Show More March 2026 – On Royal Caribbean’s Hero of the Seas, Orleans Parish Supper Club is a multi-course dining experience complete with jazz music, craft cocktails, and classic Cajun and Creole dishes. Vacationers can step back in time for the evening with an elevated experience inspired by New Orleans in the early 20th century. Marzo de 2026 - En Hero of the Seas de Royal Caribbean, Orleans Parish Supper Club ofrece una experiencia gastronómica de varios platos con música jazz, cócteles artesanales y platos clásicos cajún y criollos. Los vacacionistas pueden retroceder en el tiempo por una noche con una experiencia elevada inspirada en Nueva Orleans a principios del siglo XX.Show More March 2026 – Royal Caribbean’s Hero of the Seas is home to action-packed thrills at Category 6, the largest waterpark at sea. Adventurers can take on two new family raft slides – including the first funnel raft slide at sea – and new twists on the mat-racing Storm Chasers. Marzo de 2026 – Hero of the Seas de Royal Caribbean alberga emociones llenas de acción en Category 6, el parque acuático más grande en alta mar. Los aventureros pueden enfrentarse a dos nuevos toboganes familiares de rafting – incluido el primer tobogán con forma de embudo en el mar – y nuevas variantes del dúo de colchonetas Storm Chasers.Show More Page 1 of 235
